app.title: RainPath Virtual Staining
app.description: Virtual staining model enhancement for specific tissue types

tissue_types.name: normal
tissue_types.description: Regular cellular patterns with organized structure

tissue_types.name: tumor
tissue_types.description: Irregular cellular patterns with abnormal nuclei

tissue_types.name: fibrotic
tissue_types.description: Excessive connective tissue with linear patterns

tissue_types.name: necrotic
tissue_types.description: Dying tissue with cellular debris and fragmentation

stain_types.name: H&E
stain_types.description: Highlights cell nuclei in blue-purple and cytoplasm in pink. The most common stain used in histology.

stain_types.name: Masson's Trichrome
stain_types.description: Shows collagen fibers in blue, nuclei in black, and cytoplasm/muscle in red. Useful for identifying fibrotic tissue.

stain_types.name: PAS
stain_types.description: Highlights structures containing glycogen, mucus and basement membranes in magenta. Used to identify certain fungal infections and kidney conditions.

stain_types.name: Silver
stain_types.description: Used to visualize reticulin fibers, basement membranes, and certain microorganisms. They appear black or dark brown against a lighter background.

stain_types.name: Congo Red
stain_types.description: Used to identify amyloid deposits, which appear red-orange. Under polarized light, amyloid shows apple-green birefringence.
